subs: Beds on its Medicare cost report. A licensed bed count usually runs higher.
Every intensive and special care unit counts: adult, cardiac, surgical, burn, neonatal and pediatric.
Each inpatient stay that ended counts once, whoever paid for it.
All inpatient days divided by discharges. Answer in days, like 4.5.
Patient days divided by the bed days it had available.
Medicare Advantage plans included. Counted in days spent in a bed, not in people.
Medicaid managed care plans included. Counted in days spent in a bed, not in people.
Two half-time employees count as one. Hospital payroll only: not clinics, not contract staff.
Interns and residents: doctors training after medical school. Two half-time count as one.
From AHRQ's 2023 list of who owns which hospital, matched to Medicare's hospital list.
By the county each hospital sits in, as CMS records it.
Every one of its hospitals' latest Medicare cost report, added up.
Biggest by beds on its cost report. The answer names the hospital.
Two half-time employees count as one. Hospital payrolls only: clinics, offices and any health plan are left out.

questions.q: How many full-time-equivalent employees did Medical College of Virginia Hospitals have on its payroll in fiscal 2025?
questions.why: No other VCU Health System hospital reports more; Community Memorial Hospital is next at 595. About 9.0 for every bed.

questions.q: How many full-time-equivalent employees did VCU Health Tappahannock Hospital have on its payroll in fiscal 2025?
questions.why: That is the fewest of 3 VCU Health System hospitals; Medical College of Virginia Hospitals has the most, 7,823. About 5.6 for every bed.

questions.q: How many full-time-equivalent employees did Community Memorial Hospital have on its payroll in fiscal 2025?
questions.why: That ranks second of 3 VCU Health System hospitals; Medical College of Virginia Hospitals has the most, 7,823. About 8.5 for every bed.

questions.q: How many full-time-equivalent resident physicians trained at Medical College of Virginia Hospitals in fiscal 2025?
questions.why: Interns and residents: doctors training after medical school. Two half-time count as one.

questions.q: How many full-time-equivalent employees do VCU Health System's hospitals have on payroll, added together?
questions.why: From all 3 hospitals' latest cost reports, mostly 2025.

questions.q: How many full-time-equivalent resident physicians train in VCU Health System's hospitals, added together?
questions.why: One of its hospitals reports residents; Medical College of Virginia Hospitals trains the most, 602.

questions.q: What percent of Medical College of Virginia Hospitals's inpatient days in fiscal 2025 were for Medicare patients?
questions.why: That is the lowest of 3 VCU Health System hospitals; VCU Health Tappahannock Hospital runs highest, 72 percent. Traditional Medicare was 17 percent and Medicare Advantage plans 22 percent.

questions.q: What percent of VCU Health Tappahannock Hospital's inpatient days in fiscal 2025 were for Medicare patients?
questions.why: No other VCU Health System hospital runs higher; Community Memorial Hospital is next at 66 percent. Traditional Medicare was 41 percent and Medicare Advantage plans 30 percent.

questions.q: What percent of Community Memorial Hospital's inpatient days in fiscal 2025 were for Medicare patients?
questions.why: That ranks second of 3 VCU Health System hospitals; VCU Health Tappahannock Hospital runs highest, 72 percent. Traditional Medicare was 31 percent and Medicare Advantage plans 34 percent.

questions.q: What percent of Medical College of Virginia Hospitals's inpatient days in fiscal 2025 were for Medicaid patients?
questions.why: No other VCU Health System hospital runs higher; Community Memorial Hospital is next at 20 percent. Traditional Medicaid was 5 percent and Medicaid managed care plans 29 percent.

questions.q: What percent of VCU Health Tappahannock Hospital's inpatient days in fiscal 2025 were for Medicaid patients?
questions.why: That is the lowest of 3 VCU Health System hospitals; Medical College of Virginia Hospitals runs highest, 34 percent. Traditional Medicaid was 1 percent and Medicaid managed care plans 14 percent.

questions.q: What percent of Community Memorial Hospital's inpatient days in fiscal 2025 were for Medicaid patients?
questions.why: That ranks second of 3 VCU Health System hospitals; Medical College of Virginia Hospitals runs highest, 34 percent. Traditional Medicaid was 2 percent and Medicaid managed care plans 17 percent.

questions.q: Across all of VCU Health System's hospitals, what percent of inpatient days were for Medicare patients?
questions.why: Across every U.S. hospital's cost report it is 44 percent.

questions.q: Across all of VCU Health System's hospitals, what percent of inpatient days were for Medicaid patients?
questions.why: Across every U.S. hospital's cost report it is 24 percent.

questions.q: How many beds did Medical College of Virginia Hospitals report to Medicare for fiscal 2025?
questions.why: No other VCU Health System hospital reports more; Community Memorial Hospital is next at 70 beds.

questions.q: How many beds did VCU Health Tappahannock Hospital report to Medicare for fiscal 2025?
questions.why: That is the fewest of 3 VCU Health System hospitals; Medical College of Virginia Hospitals has the most, 865 beds.

questions.q: How many beds did Community Memorial Hospital report to Medicare for fiscal 2025?
questions.why: That ranks second of 3 VCU Health System hospitals; Medical College of Virginia Hospitals has the most, 865 beds.

questions.q: How many intensive care beds did Medical College of Virginia Hospitals report to Medicare for fiscal 2025?
questions.why: No other VCU Health System hospital reports more; Community Memorial Hospital is next at 10 ICU beds. That is 34 percent of its 865 beds.

questions.q: How many intensive care beds did VCU Health Tappahannock Hospital report to Medicare for fiscal 2025?
questions.why: That is the fewest of 3 VCU Health System hospitals; Medical College of Virginia Hospitals has the most, 290 ICU beds. That is 19 percent of its 37 beds.

questions.q: How many intensive care beds did Community Memorial Hospital report to Medicare for fiscal 2025?
questions.why: That ranks second of 3 VCU Health System hospitals; Medical College of Virginia Hospitals has the most, 290 ICU beds. That is 14 percent of its 70 beds.

questions.q: How many inpatient discharges did Medical College of Virginia Hospitals report for fiscal 2025?
questions.why: No other VCU Health System hospital discharged more; Community Memorial Hospital is next at 3,935. About 115 a day.

questions.q: How many inpatient discharges did VCU Health Tappahannock Hospital report for fiscal 2025?
questions.why: That is the fewest of 3 VCU Health System hospitals; Medical College of Virginia Hospitals discharged the most, 41,852. About 5 a day.

questions.q: How many inpatient discharges did Community Memorial Hospital report for fiscal 2025?
questions.why: That ranks second of 3 VCU Health System hospitals; Medical College of Virginia Hospitals discharged the most, 41,852. About 11 a day.

questions.q: How many days did the average inpatient stay last at Medical College of Virginia Hospitals in fiscal 2025?
questions.why: No other VCU Health System hospital kept patients longer; Community Memorial Hospital is next at 3.8 days. Across the cost reports of U.S. general hospitals it averages 5.0 days.

questions.q: How many days did the average inpatient stay last at VCU Health Tappahannock Hospital in fiscal 2025?
questions.why: That is the shortest of 3 VCU Health System hospitals; Medical College of Virginia Hospitals ran longest, 5.9 days. Across the cost reports of U.S. general hospitals it averages 5.0 days.

questions.q: How many days did the average inpatient stay last at Community Memorial Hospital in fiscal 2025?
questions.why: That ranks second of 3 VCU Health System hospitals; Medical College of Virginia Hospitals ran longest, 5.9 days. Across the cost reports of U.S. general hospitals it averages 5.0 days.

questions.q: On an average day in fiscal 2025, what percent of Medical College of Virginia Hospitals's beds had a patient in them?
questions.why: No other VCU Health System hospital ran fuller; Community Memorial Hospital is next at 58 percent.

questions.q: On an average day in fiscal 2025, what percent of VCU Health Tappahannock Hospital's beds had a patient in them?
questions.why: That is the emptiest of 3 VCU Health System hospitals; Medical College of Virginia Hospitals ran fullest, 78 percent.

questions.q: On an average day in fiscal 2025, what percent of Community Memorial Hospital's beds had a patient in them?
questions.why: That ranks second of 3 VCU Health System hospitals; Medical College of Virginia Hospitals ran fullest, 78 percent.

questions.q: How many hospitals does VCU Health System run, by the federal list of health systems?
questions.why: All of them are in Virginia. A system's own count can differ: it may count campuses on their own, or hospitals that joined after 2023.

questions.q: How many of VCU Health System's hospitals are outside a metropolitan area?
questions.why: They are Community Memorial Hospital and VCU Health Tappahannock Hospital.

questions.q: How many beds do VCU Health System's hospitals report to Medicare, added together?
questions.why: From all 3 hospitals' latest cost reports, mostly 2025.

questions.q: How many beds does VCU Health System's biggest hospital report to Medicare?
questions.why: It is Medical College of Virginia Hospitals. Community Memorial Hospital is next, with 70.

questions.q: How many intensive care beds do VCU Health System's hospitals report to Medicare, added together?
questions.why: That is 32 percent of their 972 beds. From all 3 hospitals' latest cost reports, mostly 2025.

questions.q: How many inpatient discharges did VCU Health System's hospitals report in a year, added together?
questions.why: About 131 a day. From all 3 hospitals' latest cost reports, mostly 2025.
